q1.explanationZh: heavy 把 y 变 i 再加 -ly，构成副词 heavily“大量地；沉重地”。

q2.explanationZh: heavy 形容词“重的；大量的”，heavy rain“大雨”。

q3.explanationZh: height 是 high 的名词，“高度；身高”，注意拼写 -eigh-。

q4.explanationZh: helicopter 名词“直升飞机”，注意中间是 -i-co-。

q5.explanationZh: hello 感叹词，用来打招呼“你好”，也可以用来引起注意“喂”。

q6.explanationZh: helmet 名词“头盔”，safety helmet“安全帽”。

q7.explanationZh: help 既可作动词“帮助”，也可作名词“帮助；帮手”。

q8.explanationZh: help 加 -ful 构成形容词 helpful“有帮助的”，注意只有一个 l。

q9.explanationZh: hen 名词“母鸡”，hen coop“鸡窝”。

q10.explanationZh: hence 副词“因此；所以”，常放在分号后引出结果。

q11.explanationZh: she 的宾格是 her，放在动词或介词后。

q12.explanationZh: herb 名词“药草；草”，复数 herbs。

q13.explanationZh: here 副词“在这里；向这里”，与 there“在那里”相对。

q14.explanationZh: heritage 名词“遗产；传统”，national heritage“民族遗产”。

q15.explanationZh: hero 名词“英雄”，复数要加 -es：heroes。

q16.explanationZh: hero 加 -ine 构成 heroine“女英雄；女主角”。

q17.explanationZh: hers 是名词性物主代词，相当于 her + 名词，后面不再接名词。

q18.explanationZh: she 的反身代词是 herself“她自己”。

q19.explanationZh: hesitate 动词“犹豫”，hesitate to do sth.“犹豫做某事”。

q20.explanationZh: hey 感叹词，用来引起别人注意“嘿，喂”。

q21.explanationZh: hi 感叹词，用来打招呼“嘿，你好”。

q22.explanationZh: hide 动词“隐藏；遮掩”，过去式 hid，过去分词 hidden。

q23.explanationZh: high 既可作形容词“高的”，也可作副词“高高地”。

q24.explanationZh: highlight 由 high + light 构成，名词“最精彩的部分”，动词“使突出”。

q25.explanationZh: highly 副词，表示抽象程度“高度地；非常”，如 think highly of。

q26.explanationZh: high-rise 名词“高层建筑”，中间有连字符。

q27.explanationZh: highway 由 high + way 构成，“公路”。

q28.explanationZh: hike 动词、名词同形，“徒步旅行”，go on a hike“去徒步旅行”。

q29.explanationZh: hill 名词“小山”，结尾是双写 l。

q30.explanationZh: he 的宾格是 him，放在动词或介词后。

q31.explanationZh: he 的反身代词是 himself“他自己”。

q32.explanationZh: hint 名词、动词同形，“暗示”。

q33.explanationZh: hire 名词、动词同形，“租用”，for hire“供出租”。

q34.explanationZh: he 的所有格是 his“他的”，后面接名词。

q35.explanationZh: historic 指“有历史意义的”；historical 指“历史的；与历史有关的”。

q36.explanationZh: “帮助……摆脱困难”= help out，也可说 help sb. out。

q37.explanationZh: “捉迷藏”= hide and seek，字面意思是“藏起来和寻找”。

q38.explanationZh: “到处”= here and there，“这里那里”。

q40.explanationZh: “看得起，高度评价”= think highly of，highly 表示抽象的“高度地”。

q41.explanationZh: “作徒步旅行”= go on a hike，hike 在这里是名词。

q42.explanationZh: “向某人求助”= ask sb. for help，ask sb. for sth.“向某人要某物”。

q43.explanationZh: “请随便吃/用……”= help oneself to，to 是介词，后接名词。

q44.explanationZh: “在某方面帮助某人”= help sb. with sth.，介词用 with。

q45.explanationZh: “帮助某人做某事”= help sb. (to) do sth.，to 可以省略。

q47.explanationZh: “这里还有一个例子”= Here is one more example.，here 放句首，主谓倒装。

q48.explanationZh: “通常认为……”= It is commonly/generally/widely held that ...，held 是 hold 的过去分词，表示“认为”。

q49.explanationZh: “……的高度”= the height of sth.，height 是 high 的名词。

q50.explanationZh: “犹豫做某事”= hesitate to do sth.，后接动词不定式。

q51.explanationZh: your kind 后需要名词，help 作名词“帮助”，Thank you for your kind help.“谢谢你好意相助”。

q52.explanationZh: in height 表示“在身高上”，用名词 height。

q53.explanationZh: could not 后用动词原形，hide“掩盖”自己的窘态。

q54.explanationZh: a 后需要名词，说累了是一种“暗示”，用 hint。

q55.explanationZh: 修饰 treaty 用形容词，“具有历史意义的”条约用 historic。

q56.explanationZh: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词，high 的最高级 highest。

q57.explanationZh: persuade 后接宾语，用宾格 her 或 him，persuade sb. not to do sth.“劝某人不要做某事”。

q58.explanationZh: 修饰动词 shut 用副词，heavily“重重地”。

q59.explanationZh: hesitate to do sth.“犹豫做某事”，主语 He 是第三人称单数，一般现在时加 -s。

q60.explanationZh: gather here“聚集在这里”，here 是副词，修饰 gather。

q61.sampleAnswer: After receiving a lot of praise from his fans, he was filled with different emotions and couldn’t help crying out loud when he was recalling all kinds of hardships at the beginning of his business.
references: After receiving a lot of praise from his fans, he was filled with different emotions and couldn’t help crying out loud when he was recalling all kinds of hardships at the beginning of his business.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “不禁……”用 can’t help doing sth.，本句是过去的事，用 couldn’t help crying；“感慨万千”可译为 be filled with different emotions。

q62.sampleAnswer: It is very late; hence you must go to bed.
references: It is very late; hence you must go to bed.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “因此”用副词 hence，放在分号后引出结果。

q63.sampleAnswer: Many traditional crafts are an important part of our national heritage and should be kept alive.
references: Many traditional crafts are an important part of our national heritage and should be kept alive.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “民族遗产”= national heritage；“被传承下去”用被动 should be kept alive。

q64.sampleAnswer: The health advisor recommends taking herbs to promote recovery.
references: The health advisor recommends taking herbs to promote recovery.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: “草药”用 herb 的复数 herbs；recommend doing sth.“推荐做某事”，to promote recovery 表目的。

q65.sampleAnswer: Though they are really great, they have never thought of themselves as heroes.
references: Though they are really great, they have never thought of themselves as heroes.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: hero 的复数是 heroes；think of oneself as ...“认为自己是……”。注意英语里 though 和 but 不能同时用。

q66.sampleAnswer: Give me a rough idea of how the doll is made. Just the highlights.
references: Give me a rough idea of how the doll is made. Just the highlights.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: highlight 作名词“最重要的部分”，“讲讲主要的”用 Just the highlights；“大致介绍”= give sb. a rough idea of。

q67.sampleAnswer: High-tech firms are the leaders of the knowledge economy and also the main players in the fifth wave of M&A.
references: High-tech firms are the leaders of the knowledge economy and also the main players in the fifth wave of M&A.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “高科技企业”= high-tech firms；“领头羊”可译为 leaders，“主角”可译为 main players。

q68.sampleAnswer: I got out of breath running up the hill from the station.
references: I got out of breath running up the hill from the station.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “跑上山”= run up the hill；“喘不上气”= get out of breath，running 表伴随的动作。

q69.sampleAnswer: It was a passer-by who saved the man trying to kill himself without considering his own safety.
references: It was a passer-by who saved the man trying to kill himself without considering his own safety.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “是……救了”用强调句 It was ... who ...；“不顾自己的安危”= without considering his own safety，his 是所有格。

q70.sampleAnswer: Why don’t you hint to the director that it’s time you had a raise in pay?
references: Why don’t you hint to the director that it’s time you had a raise in pay?

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: hint 作动词，hint to sb. that ...“向某人暗示……”；it’s time (that) sb. did sth.“该是某人做某事的时候了”，从句用过去式。
